narrative.overview: Warm near-white paper, ink pill buttons and rounded Fredoka headlines. Each section is a centered statement over one framed demo of the app noticing a habit, nudging, and logging in one tap. Demos stay neutral so the single orange moment, the thing Aviary learned or did, stands out. Scope is only the public / page inside .lp; the money lesson is parked.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper page, white cards, hairline warm-grey borders.
Ink pills for every CTA; orange is never a CTA fill.
Orange marks the learned or answered moment only.
Fredoka for headlines and every number; Nunito 800 for emphasis.
Centered statement, then one framed demo, repeated.
Every demo amount is labeled sample data.

rules.name: The One Orange Moment Rule
rules.body: Orange fills appear only on the thing Aviary learned or the action that logs a spend.

rules.name: The Ink CTA Rule
rules.body: Every way off the page is an ink or ghost pill, never orange.

rules.name: The Pastels Are Envelopes Rule
rules.body: The four pastels mean envelope or a way to log, nothing else.

rules.name: The Fredoka Numbers Rule
rules.body: Amounts, times and counts are Fredoka 500; the words around them are Nunito.

rules.name: The Weight-Not-Case Rule
rules.body: Emphasis is Nunito 800, never uppercase letter-spaced labels.

rules.name: The Centered Statement Rule
rules.body: One section, one headline, one framed demo.

rules.name: The Aviary Side Lifts Rule
rules.body: In comparisons the alternative is flat and the Aviary side is a white card with Ambient shadow.

dos: Do keep every CTA an ink or ghost pill.
Do spend orange only on the learned or logged moment; use Burnt Orange Ink for orange text.
Do set amounts in Fredoka with ₹ and en-IN grouping.
Do label demo numbers as sample data.
Do lift the Aviary side of a comparison and keep the alternative flat.
Do pause loops off screen, offer pause, and hold the finished state under reduced motion.
Do use · as the meta-line separator.
donts: Don't fill a CTA, section background or headline in Aviary Orange.
Don't use the envelope pastels outside envelope and way-to-log contexts.
Don't use cool grey or pure black shadows.
Don't add uppercase, letter-spaced eyebrow labels above headlines.
Don't use em dashes or uncontracted forms in copy.
Don't carry these rules into the dashboard, mobile app or legal pages, or revive the parked money lesson's palette.
